verdict.rationale: Expensify documents some spend-visibility pieces. Ask Expensify AI gives 'instant answers and charts for anything in your account, from monthly spend to a full quarterly flux analysis.' SmartScan extracts merchant, date and total in real time with no overnight batching, and existing corporate cards can be imported. However, nothing shows a same-day spend view broken down by team, category and merchant, and an older community report says SmartScan categorization is often wrong, which weakens category-level views. Missing for 10: documented real-time card transaction feed or dashboard, explicit breakdowns by team/department, category and merchant, evidence that data appears the day spend happens rather than after reports are submitted, and independent hands-on corroboration.
